title: Mini-Car Sunrise Tour in Hollywood with Breakfast
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
In order to operate the mini-car, drivers must be able to speak, read, and understand English for safety purposes.
Minimum Driving age is 21 years old
Minimum passenger age is 7 years old
Drivers require a valid drivers license
Maximum weight per person is 250 lbs (113 kg)
Maximum combined weight of 2 passengers in the same mini-car is 400 lbs (181 kg) per vehicle
Maximum height is 6 feet 4 inches (76 cm) when riding with a passenger
All participants must be in good physical health; consult your doctor if you have back problems, certain medical conditions, pregnant women
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Take on LA's sunrise minicar tour of some of the city's top sights. Get behind the wheel of your 2-seater open-air vehicle as you drive yourself through the scenic Los Angeles hills, while the city's still sleeping. Take in panoramic morning views from the Griffith Observatory, and refuel with a continental breakfast as you marvel at an unparalleled view of The Hollywood Sign. Consider upgrading to the picture package for a perfect souvenir.

- Cruise around Los Angeles in a fun minicar, and feel the wind as you drive

- Visit Griffith Observatory

- See The HOLLYWOOD Sign

- Snap photos of iconic LA sights—the Hollywood Sign and Griffith Observatory

- Enjoy great inclusions—continental breakfast, binoculars, and minicar use
